--- is_distinct_from_nested.sql
(1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2) IS DISTINCT FROM (3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 4)

--- AST
&ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
  Left: &ast.ParenExpr{
    Rparen: 21,
    Expr:   &ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
      Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 1,
        ValueEnd: 2,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",
      },
      Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 20,
        ValueEnd: 21,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "2",
      },
    },
  },
  Right: &ast.ParenExpr{
    Lparen: 40,
    Rparen: 65,
    Expr:   &ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
      Not:  true,
      Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 41,
        ValueEnd: 42,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "3",
      },
      Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 64,
        ValueEnd: 65,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "4",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
(1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2) IS DISTINCT FROM (3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 4)
